counterhypotheses_checked.hypothesis: An occupied entry refreshes the stamp, so repeated calls postpone the deadline.
counterhypotheses_checked.evidence: 0x495874d occupied tag2 returns via 0x495899c with the existing node+0x218+40*index pointer; no occupied-path call or stamp initialization. Initializer 0x4958834 and row insertion are only on the vacant path.

counterhypotheses_checked.hypothesis: Suppressed requests omit the new reason or already-sent rows skip deadline formation.
counterhypotheses_checked.evidence: 0x44b8206 reason insertion precedes 0x44b824b deadline helper, time comparisons and 0x44b827a sent test. This also explains the separately specified DeadlineRange-after-registration/reason policy.
counterhypotheses_checked.result: Rejected; equality at deadline admits, but sent=true still suppresses after deadline computation.

counterhypotheses_checked.hypothesis: Finite binary64 delay overflow saturates to i64MAX/MIN instead of mapping to zero.
counterhypotheses_checked.evidence: 0x1459cbe..0x1459ce1 classifies the rounded product before clamp/truncation. Absolute encoding above maximum finite leaves +0, so initially finite multiplication overflow belongs to the zero class. Finite +/-2^63 endpoint treatment is separate.
counterhypotheses_checked.result: Rejected. Exact integer product-rounding oracle matches native conditional IEEE relation; separately calibrated host arithmetic matched every finite corpus outcome.

counterhypotheses_checked.hypothesis: Negative-year calendars, borrow across midnight or date-range failure break the composition.
counterhypotheses_checked.evidence: Full time and calendar bodies read. Euclidean seconds/nanos and day carry, 400-year normalization, predecessor-year branch, canonical flag tables and final year limits compose with integer day arithmetic. Independent closed year-start formula and binary-search inverse reproduce all fixture outcomes; full401/400-byte tables match.
counterhypotheses_checked.result: No defect found in admitted canonical non-leap-second domain. InvalidTime and DeadlineRange are explicitly new policies; no panic/unwind equivalence asserted.

counterhypotheses_checked.hypothesis: Calls made before/after mutation may invalidate the theorem through escaped row/time/key pointers.
counterhypotheses_checked.evidence: CALL-FRAMES explicitly requires preservation of complete map/reason nodes, already escaped pointers, key/time/output and stack spans across allocation, comparison, log/stat and lock normal returns. Registration log/stat precede time reads; emission log precedes sent-store, and stat5 follows it.
counterhypotheses_checked.result: Premise is explicit and necessary; no inferred atomicity, allocator equivalence, reentrancy or exception-state theorem.
